meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器完成测试、填表、截图和数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来完成测试或数据采集
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions for testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or data extraction

howto.what: 装上后，你可以让 Claude 通过 agent-browser 打开网页、点击和填写表单、截屏、提取页面内容，还能做网页测试。它会先列出页面可操作元素，再按你的指令去点或填。
howto.when: 当你想让 Claude 浏览网页、填写表单、截取屏幕截图等网页操作时，它会自动用这个技能。说清网址和目标即可。

say.text: 打开 example.com，然后截图保存
say.note: Claude 会开浏览器并截图

say.text: 在 example.com 填表，提交后截图
say.note: Claude 会定位表单并填写提交

say.text: 获取这个页面的标题和所有链接
say.note: Claude 会读取页面并返回结果

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can use agent-browser to open pages, click/fill forms, screenshot, extract data, and test web apps. It lists interactive elements first, then follows your commands.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to browse websites, fill forms, take screenshots, or do other web page tasks. Just give the URL and the goal.

say_en.text: Open example.com and save a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude will open the browser and screenshot it.

say_en.text: Fill the form on example.com, submit it, then screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude will find, fill, submit, and capture.

say_en.text: Get the page title and all links from this page.
say_en.note: Claude will extract and return that info.
